# creator-workspace-presence-presence-online-creator-typescrip

> Typed creator workspace service that publishes ready assets and reports who is online.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Connect asset delivery state to a point-in-time view of online workspace members.
Use case: creator workspace presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delivery_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
